project.name: ai-badger
project.summary: Agent-instruction framework distributed as a Claude Code plugin. Python 3.10+ scripts (detect/scaffold/validate/index_build/drift) materialize a per-repo .ai-badger/ scaffold from a features/{stack|common}/{feature} catalog. Stdlib-only except two declared dependencies (engine/requirements.txt): jsonschema is required — validation refuses rather than silently passing — and pyyaml is optional, guarded, and degrades to a printed note. Two .mjs helper scripts under skills/maintain-agent-instructions/.
project.domain: Developer tooling: agent instruction catalogs and repo scaffolding.
